items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The interviewee discusses Billy Strayhorn only in the context of his collaboration with Duke Ellington ('Duke and Strayhorn was fantastic') and as the composer of a tune, without indicating any personal interaction or direct professional relationship with Strayhorn himself.

ctx.x: up place like that. There’s no place to get that experience you know. And you can’t get out of high school and go straight with Count Basie’s band.
Well actually, Billy and I, we had the experience and the feeling of that, going to clubs and jamming, you know, like jazz clubs.
